column2: Describe your day-to-day role at Meta.
I oversee a team tasked with securing new renewable energy projects to continue
matching 100% of our electricity use with renewable energy. This includes
understanding data center capacity and electricity demand signals from the business,
sourcing projects opportunities and negotiating agreements.
How has the company's approach to renewable energy
From the early days of the program, we have always looked to add new renewable
energy projects in close proximity to our operations. As we’ve continued to add
renewable energy to the markets in which we operate, we’ve started to think more about
the impact of each incremental MWh of clean energy we add to the grid. At the same
time, we are working to maximize emissions reductions across the electricity system.
To achieve this, we focus on staying ahead of the curve and thinking creatively. We are
